deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern (application opens September 15).
deadline.quote: Deadline: December 1 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time

gre_general.value: BE does not accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Biological Engineering does not accept GRE scores and will not consider GRE scores during the evaluation of your application.

gre_subject.quote: will not consider GRE scores during the evaluation of your application

english_waiver.value: BE offers no English-test waivers; Indian applicants must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo.
english_waiver.quote: the Biological Engineering Department does not offer ELP waivers.

supervisor.value: Students do research rotations in the fall and winter of year 1, then match with a BE faculty advisor.
supervisor.quote: BE PhD students complete research rotations in the fall and winter of their first year and match with a BE Faculty member as a research advisor.

funding.value: All BE PhD students are fully funded (tuition, health insurance, living stipend).
funding.quote: All MIT Biological Engineering Ph.D. students are fully funded for tuition, health insurance, and a stipend that covers living costs.

entry_route.value: MIT does not require a master's degree to apply for a PhD; you can apply from a bachelor's degree (final-year students may be admitted if the degree is awarded before enrolment).
entry_route.quote: The Institute does not require applicants to hold a master’s or other advanced degree in order to apply to a Ph.D program.

notes: MIT's biomedical-engineering-type PhD department. The Harvard-MIT HST Medical Engineering and Medical Physics PhD is recorded under biomed.
